selected_work.name: HOLDOUT
selected_work.value: Audit the dataset before trusting the score. Holdout finds leakage, quantifies how much a validation score survives once suspicious columns are removed, verifies its own findings and returns Ship, Review or Block.
selected_work.signal: Six-stage audit, eight deterministic detectors, second-path verification. No LLM verdict.

selected_work.name: EVIDENT
selected_work.value: Hiring evidence, not hiring scores. Claims, sources and interview answers flow through six review states; the human decides.
selected_work.signal: Three AI providers with automatic failover. Zod-validated orchestration before persistence.

selected_work.name: AIRLOOM
selected_work.value: An air-quality forecast turned into a day plan: when to move, commute, ventilate and what to change. Every recommendation states its reason and its data source.
selected_work.signal: Deterministic planning core. Gemini explains the plan but never invents a reading.

selected_work.name: CAREMESH
selected_work.value: Care coordination where the elder stays in control — medications, appointments, reminders and a trusted care circle.
selected_work.signal: Scrypt passcodes, HMAC-signed sessions, server-side authorization on every protected write.
